title: YouCoded name and icons — round 6: the real mascot, doing things

steps.path: Website header, marketing — and help pages, where the name stands alone
steps.headline: Which name ideas do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Every mascot is your app-icon mascot with its exact body, arms and legs — only its pose and face change. Each is shown big, in the header, in three themes, and alone on a help page.

variants.label: A1 The punch
variants.summary: Your intro animation frozen: the mascot uppercuts the Y and knocks it back. Site headline lettering.

variants.label: A2 Peeking over
variants.summary: The mascot-shaped letters (N1) with the mascot hiding behind them, peeking over between "you" and "coded".

variants.label: A3 Sitting on the "d"
variants.summary: Chunky sticker letters (N4) with the mascot perched on the last "d", waving.

variants.label: A4 Holding up the C
variants.summary: The mascot stands in the word and lifts the "C" over its head like a trophy.

variants.label: A5 Between you and coded
variants.summary: The mascot holds a hand out to each half: it's what connects you to the code.

steps.headline: Which app icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Each is shown at true size on a Windows taskbar, Mac dock and browser tab, next to today's icon, and dressed in three other themes.

variants.label: B1 Punching the Y
variants.summary: The intro's punch as an icon, on the light tile you chose in September.

variants.label: B2 Peeking over the edge
variants.summary: The mascot pulls itself up over the icon's bottom edge, mitts on the ledge.

variants.label: B3 Building with Y and C
variants.summary: Toy blocks: the mascot lifting the C into place. "Build your own", literally.

variants.label: B4 Mid-hop
variants.summary: Caught at the top of a happy hop, shadow below. All character, clearest when tiny.

variants.label: B5 Costume change
variants.summary: Half purple mascot, half Strawberry Kitty: same body, any look.

variants.label: B6 Hanging off the Y
variants.summary: A big white Y on deep purple, the mascot swinging from its arm.

steps.headline: Which installer icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: All three stay in the app icon's family: same light tile, same mascot. Shown in a Downloads folder and next to today's installer icon.

variants.label: C1 Moving in
variants.summary: The mascot carries a box with a download arrow on it onto your computer.

variants.label: C2 Riding the arrow down
variants.summary: The mascot rides a big download arrow down like a slide.

variants.label: C3 Jumping into the strip
variants.summary: Today's installer (your September pick) with the mascot leaping into the download strip.
